product.required_finishing: Mark both dice with thin ink as directed in README.md before play.
product.summary: Historical backgammon on a sculpted Sun: rival streams of single-tail and fork-tail drops circulate along open lanes, send lone drops to the raised flare bar, and rain home. Includes thirty stackable drops, two dice to ink before play, two cups, and illustrated playing instructions.
product.title: Rainward Sun
